integrity: Complete proof and standalone reproducibility checker included. Source oscillator, period and edge-normal decay explicitly credited. Independent review not performed.
scientific_limitations: One-sided forward-mode section map; not a uniqueness theorem for all hybrid switching states or a global full-plane basin. Origin excluded. Regular polygon, uniform positive omega and lambda, nonnegative mu. Near-center asymptotics are fixed-parameter. Closely related 2012 and 2019 primary full texts inaccessible; priority provisional.
title: Exact one-sided crossing and a three-regime central startup transition in regular polygonal oscillators
